symbol_order: High nibble then low nibble; one four-bit SD symbol per clock
crc_cross_check: Independent binascii.crc_hqx over packed per-lane bit streams matches bitwise implementation
interpretation: The retained payload is exactly consistent with eight missing four-bit data symbols and four bytes of CRC entering the payload. This is stronger evidence of symbol-count disagreement than a simple stuck lane or independent random bit flips.
limitations: This is an alignment model of one CRC-failed host RAM buffer against a historical verified same-card/LBA0 sector, not a wire capture.
Repeated symbols can make exact deletion locations locally ambiguous.
It does not prove reflections, which endpoint saw extra/missing clock edges, or whether the discrepancy occurred on the wire, at host sampling, or in another part of the receive path.
Historical agreement and matching CRC prefix are strong consistency checks, not a new successful read or fresh independent proof of unchanged media.
